title: Sample size estimation for a flexible phase II oncology trial design using two dependent endpoints with nested response metrics

detail.title: Sample size estimation for a flexible phase II oncology trial design using two dependent endpoints with nested response metrics
detail.abstract: Phase II oncology trials are often designed using a single primary efficacy endpoint, even when multiple clinically relevant response metrics are available. When two endpoints are based on nested response metrics, such as objective response rate and disease control rate or progression-free survival at two ordered time points, success on the more stringent endpoint implies success on the broader endpoint. This structure induces a known dependence relationship that can be incorporated into sample size estimation and decision-rule construction. We develop a flexible phase II design framework for two primary endpoints with nested response metrics. The framework includes union-based designs for declaring activity on at least one endpoint, intersection-based designs for requiring activity on both endpoints, and multiplicity-adjusted designs for endpoint-specific inference with strong familywise error-rate control. For the multiplicity-adjusted setting, we propose Hochberg-type and Holm-type designs and provide sample size optimization algorithms based on the nested dependence structure. An application to a phase II trial of sintilimab in recurrent or progressive meningioma illustrates the approach using 12-month and 6-month progression-free survival. Compared with a Bonferroni design, the Holm-type and Hochberg-type designs can reduce the required sample size while maintaining prespecified error-rate and power requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文针对II期肿瘤试验中嵌套反应指标（如客观缓解率与疾病控制率，或两个时间点的无进展生存期）的结构依赖关系，开发了一套灵活的两主终点设计框架，包括联合型、交集型和多重性校正型设计（Hochberg型和Holm型），并证明相较Bonferroni设计可显著降低所需样本量。
AI.research_question: 如何为具有嵌套反应指标结构的II期肿瘤试验设计高效的两主终点统计框架，在控制错误率的同时优化样本量？
AI.motivation: 传统II期肿瘤试验通常只使用单一主要疗效终点，但临床上存在多个相关反应指标（如客观缓解率与疾病控制率，或6个月与12个月无进展生存期）。由于嵌套指标存在已知的依赖关系（更严格端点的成功意味着更宽松端点的成功），现有方法未能充分利用这一结构信息来优化试验设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嵌套反应指标的依赖关系理论、多重假设检验中的错误率控制理论（FWER）、Hochberg和Holm多重比较程序、Bonferroni校正。
AI.method: 开发了三种类型的设计框架：(1) 联合型设计（至少一个终点显著即宣告活性）；(2) 交集型设计（两个终点均需显著）；(3) 多重性校正型设计（每个终点分别推断，控制家庭wise错误率）。针对第三类提出了基于嵌套依赖结构的Hochberg型和Holm型设计，并开发了样本量优化算法。以信迪利单抗治疗复发/进展性脑膜瘤的II期试验为案例，使用12个月和6个月无进展生存期作为嵌套终点进行验证。
AI.findings: 提出了一种利用嵌套指标依赖关系的两主终点设计框架。在多重性校正设置下，Hochberg型和Holm型设计相比Bonferroni设计能够显著减少所需样本量，同时维持预设的错误率和检验效能。案例研究展示了该方法的实际可行性和效率优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将嵌套反应指标的依赖关系结构引入II期试验的两主终点设计，扩展了多重假设检验方法在肿瘤临床试验设计中的应用，提出了基于嵌套依赖的Hochberg型和Holm型样本量优化算法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为II期肿瘤试验提供了灵活、高效的两终点设计工具箱，允许研究者根据临床需求选择联合型、交集型或多重性校正型设计，并通过案例展示了在脑膜瘤试验中可大幅降低样本量，节约试验资源和时间。

title: Tail Risk Transmission in Global FX Markets: Evidence from Quantile Contemporaneous and Lagged R²-Decomposed Connectedness
affiliations: University of Ibadan - Faculty of Public Health, Dominican University, Ibadan , affiliation not provided to SSRN and Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Tail Risk Transmission in Global FX Markets: Evidence from Quantile Contemporaneous and Lagged R²-Decomposed Connectedness
detail.abstract: This study examines tail-risk transmission in global foreign exchange (FX) markets using a quantile contemporaneous and lagged R²-decomposed connectedness framework. Daily returns for eight major FX pairs (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, USD/CAD, AUD/USD, USD/CNY, and NZD/USD) are analysed over the full sample from 3 January 2006 to 12 June 2026 and across five major stress episodes. The crisis periods cover the Global Financial Crisis, the European Debt Crisis, the COVID-19 pandemic shock, the Russia–Ukraine war shock and the monetary policy tightening era. The empirical framework combines six major approaches (quantile regression, pseudo-R² decomposition, directional connectedness, network analysis, hedge and portfolio performance evaluation). The results show that contemporaneous connectedness dominates lagged connectedness across all quantiles, indicating that FX shocks are transmitted mainly through same-day adjustment. However, lagged transmission is more prominent during crisis periods, especially at the lower and upper tails. AUD/USD emerges as a persistent net transmitter of lower-tail shocks, while EUR/USD–USD/CHF, AUD/USD–NZD/USD and EUR/USD–GBP/USD represent important bilateral channels. Network results confirm that FX dependence is stronger in the tails than at the median while hedge and portfolio results show that dynamic hedging reduces exchange-rate risk more effectively than static diversification. Overall, the evidence demonstrates that global FX tail-risk transmission is quantile-dependent, crisis-sensitive and directionally heterogeneous.

AI.tldr: 本文运用分位数同期与滞后R²分解的关联性框架，研究全球外汇市场的尾部风险传导。发现同期传导主导外汇冲击传递，但危机期间滞后传导更为显著；澳元/美元是尾部冲击的持续净传递者；尾部依赖性强于中位数；动态对冲优于静态分散化。结果表明全球外汇尾部风险传导具有分位数依赖性、危机敏感性和方向异质性。
AI.research_question: 全球外汇市场的尾部风险是如何在不同分位数、不同危机时期以及不同货币对之间进行传导的？
AI.motivation: 传统外汇市场关联性研究多关注均值层面的溢出效应，忽略了极端风险（尾部风险）的传导机制及其在危机时期的动态变化。理解尾部风险传导对于风险管理、投资组合优化和政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数回归、伪R²分解、方向性关联性、网络分析、对冲与投资组合绩效评估。
AI.method: 采用分位数同期与滞后R²分解的关联性框架，结合六大方法（分位数回归、伪R²分解、方向性关联性、网络分析、对冲与投资组合绩效评估），分析8种主要外汇对从2006年1月3日至2026年6月12日的日度数据，覆盖五次重大危机事件。
AI.findings: 1) 同期传导主导外汇冲击传递，但危机期间滞后传导更显著，尤其在尾部；2) AUD/USD是持续的下尾冲击净传递者；3) 欧元/美元-瑞士法郎、澳元/美元-新西兰元/美元、欧元/美元-英镑/美元是重要双边渠道；4) 尾部依赖性比中位数更强；5) 动态对冲比静态分散化更有效降低汇率风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分位数同期与滞后R²分解的关联性框架，区分了同期与滞后的尾部风险传导机制，揭示了尾部风险传导的分位数依赖性和方向异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外汇市场参与者提供了尾部风险传导的量化证据，表明动态对冲策略在极端市场条件下优于静态分散化策略，为风险管理和投资组合优化提供了实证依据。

title: Structural determinants of new graduate nurse migration in Japan: A 17-year prefectural panel study

detail.title: Structural determinants of new graduate nurse migration in Japan: A 17-year prefectural panel study
detail.abstract: Abstract Background: Geographic maldistribution of the nursing workforce remains a major challenge for health systems. Although the expansion of baccalaureate nursing education may strengthen professional preparation, its association with the regional retention of newly graduated nurses remains unclear.Objective: To examine whether changes in nursing education, hospital employment capacity, and regional labour-market conditions were associated with the retention and inter-prefectural movement of newly graduated nurses in Japan.Design : Retrospective prefectural panel study.Methods: We used 799 prefecture-year observations from all 47 prefectures in Japan between 2007 and 2023. Data were compiled from the Survey of Nursing School Enrollment and Graduate Employment Destinations and linked at the prefecture-year level with other official statistics from e-Stat using prefectural codes and calendar year. A Mundlak-extended linear mixed model estimated with restricted maximum likelihood was applied to distinguish within-prefecture changes over time from between-prefecture structural differences. The primary outcomes were the prefectural retention rate and the out-of-prefecture internship hospital attraction rate.Results: In the within-prefecture analysis, a higher university graduate ratio was associated with lower retention (β = -0.009, 95% confidence interval [-0.013, -0.004], p < 0.001), whereas a higher internship hospital employment rate was associated with higher retention (β = 0.052, 95% confidence interval [0.046, 0.059], p < 0.001). Greater hospital bed capacity was also positively associated with retention (β = 0.054, 95% confidence interval [0.023, 0.085], p = 0.001). In the attraction model, higher long-term regional wage levels were associated with stronger out-of-prefecture attraction to internship hospitals (β = 0.099, 95% confidence interval [0.047, 0.151], p < 0.001).Conclusions: Regional workforce policy should consider not only educational expansion but also the employment capacity of local training hospitals. Strengthening local training-to-employment pathways may support the regional retention of newly graduated nurses.Registration : not registered.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于日本47个都道府县2007—2023年的面板数据，发现大学护理教育扩招反而降低了新毕业护士的地区留任率，而本地实习医院就业率和医院床位容量则显著提升了留任率；长期区域工资水平能吸引外县护士流入实习医院。提示区域劳动力政策应兼顾教育扩招与本地培训医院的就业吸纳能力。
AI.research_question: 护理教育扩张、医院就业容量和区域劳动力市场条件的变化，是否与日本新毕业护士的地区留任和跨县流动相关？
AI.motivation: 护理人力地理分布不均一直是卫生系统的重大挑战，尽管学士级护理教育扩张可能加强专业准备，但其与新毕业护士地区留任之间的关系尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、区域劳动力流动理论、教育与职业匹配理论。
AI.method: 回顾性县级面板研究，使用2007—2023年日本47个都道府县的799条县-年观测数据，采用Mundlak扩展线性混合模型（限制最大似然估计），区分县内随时间变化与县间结构性差异。
AI.findings: 县内分析：大学毕业生比例越高，留任率越低（β=-0.009，p<0.001）；实习医院就业率越高，留任率越高（β=0.052，p<0.001）；医院床位容量越大，留任率越高（β=0.054，p=0.001）。吸引模型：长期区域工资水平越高，对外县实习医院的吸引力越强（β=0.099，p<0.001）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了教育扩张与地区留任之间的非预期负向关联，挑战了"教育提升必然促进本地留存"的默认假设；为人力资本区域流动理论提供了护理行业的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示区域护理人力政策不能仅依赖教育扩招，还需强化本地培训医院到就业的衔接路径；为卫生人力资源区域规划提供了基于证据的政策杠杆（实习医院就业率、床位容量、区域工资水平）。

title: EF-LLM: A Continual Learning-Based Framework for AI-Assisted Automation, Enhanced Sparse Prediction, and Hallucination Detection
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, UNSW Canberra and University of New South Wales

detail.title: EF-LLM: A Continual Learning-Based Framework for AI-Assisted Automation, Enhanced Sparse Prediction, and Hallucination Detection
detail.abstract: Accurate prediction helps achieve supply-demand balance in energy systems, thereby supporting operational decision-making and scheduling.  Traditional models, which lack AI-assisted automation, often rely heavily on expert knowledge, incur high labor costs, and perform poorly under sparse-data conditions. To address these challenges, this work proposes an Energy Forecasting Large Language Model (EF-LLM), which integrates domain knowledge and temporal data for time-series forecasting while supporting both pre-forecast operations and post-forecast decision-making. EF-LLM’s human–artificial intelligence (AI) interaction capabilities further lower the entry barrier for forecasting tasks and reduce the need for additional expert involvement. To support these functions, a continual learning framework with updatable Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and a multi-channel architecture is developed to align heterogeneous multimodal data, enabling EF-LLM to continuously acquire and adapt multimodal knowledge. In addition, EF-LLM improves prediction accuracy under sparse-data conditions by leveraging its ability to process and fuse multimodal information. A Fusion Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (F-PEFT) method is further introduced to effectively exploit both time-series data and textual information. EF-LLM is also the first energy-specific LLM to detect hallucinations and quantify their occurrence rate, achieved via multi-task learning and semantic similarity analysis. This work has achieved success in energy prediction scenarios for load, PV, and wind power forecast.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种能源预测大语言模型（EF-LLM），通过集成领域知识与时序数据，结合持续学习框架、多通道架构和融合参数高效微调方法，在稀疏数据条件下提升预测精度，并首次实现能源领域大模型的幻觉检测与量化。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够集成领域知识与时序数据、支持人机交互、在稀疏数据条件下保持高精度，并能检测自身幻觉的能源预测大语言模型？
AI.motivation: 传统能源预测模型过度依赖专家知识、人力成本高、在稀疏数据条件下表现不佳，且缺乏AI辅助自动化能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大语言模型（LLM）、持续学习（Continual Learning）、低秩自适应（LoRA）、参数高效微调（PEFT）、多模态数据融合、多任务学习、语义相似性分析。
AI.method: 提出EF-LLM模型，包含：①持续学习框架与可更新LoRA模块；②多通道架构对齐异构多模态数据；③融合参数高效微调方法（F-PEFT）联合利用时序与文本信息；④基于多任务学习和语义相似性分析的幻觉检测机制。
AI.findings: EF-LLM在负荷、光伏、风电等能源预测场景中取得成功，有效提升了稀疏数据条件下的预测精度，并首次实现了能源领域大模型的幻觉检测与量化。
AI.theory_contributions: ①首次将大语言模型应用于能源预测领域并实现幻觉检测；②提出了面向异构多模态数据对齐的持续学习框架；③创新性地设计了F-PEFT方法以融合时序与文本信息。
AI.practical_contributions: ①降低能源预测任务的专业门槛，减少专家依赖；②通过人机交互提升预测自动化水平；③在稀疏数据场景下提升预测可靠性，支撑能源系统调度决策。
